verdict.rationale: Zamzar lists dedicated converters for every format in the story (SVG, JPG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP) and advertises a compression feature. Nothing in the evidence shows user-adjustable quality, resize/dimension, or compression-level parameters in the web app or the API jobs endpoint, so the 'control' half of the story is mostly unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented quality/resolution settings for image conversions, resize controls, configurable compression levels, API conversion options, independent hands-on corroboration.
